verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents retention settings, retention periods, or tenant-level data deletion controls for Vanta itself. The only related items are adjacent: a single 'Delete a contract by ID' endpoint, control deactivation, and GDPR 'privacy workflows' that help customers run their own compliance programs. None of these is a documented capability to control data retention and deletion in Vanta.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
